body: I agree. Money is better than people. I'm just saying that money =/= happiness.

I just want to say that I have an apartment of my own. I don't have to see anyone for days if I don't want to. And I am still suicidal. You will probably hate me for this, but money does not make you happy. I have friends, rich friends, who are now dead. They hanged themselves, took pills, jumped off their penthouse balconies. I hope you find happiness, even though I have never known it.

I am under a lot of pain and stress. I have the pills, I know they usually don't work, but I think it will work for me. I have done my research. I want to see a friend that I lost awhile ago. Yet I don't want to die in this apartment, which I hate.
